correctness.rationale: For a forest support S, leaf pivots give weighted alternating adjacency rank 2 nu(S); the pre-existing Kirillov orbit character formula then gives ch_T(i;q)=q^(n-2i) W_i(q-1), with W_i integer support matching polynomials. New independent NetworkX unlabeled-tree generator enumerated exactly 1,1,1,2,3,6,11,23,47,106 classes through n=10, and an independently coded vertex-subset matching DP computed every subset profile. It found zero profile collisions through n=9 and exactly one at n=10; its 19 coefficient entries reproduce those listed for the two given trees. Explicit graphs have diameters 7 and 6, hence are nonisomorphic; prior Mainkar rigidity distinguishes Lie algebras in odd characteristic. Since integer W_i polynomials coincide, all odd q follow by polynomial identity, not field sampling. Group nonisomorphism is asserted only over odd prime fields, not all extension fields.
